// The process module, imported or required, is process: HOME off its env is
// refused as it is off the global. A line ending in "// flagged" must be
// reported; every other line must pass.
import process from 'node:process';
import * as processNamespace from 'process';
import { env } from 'node:process';
import { env as processEnv, default as defaultProcess } from 'process';
const requiredProcess = require('node:process');
const { env: requiredEnv } = require('process');
process.env.HOME; // flagged
process.env['HOME']; // flagged
processNamespace.env.HOME; // flagged
defaultProcess['env'].HOME; // flagged
env.HOME; // flagged
processEnv['HOME']; // flagged
requiredProcess.env.HOME; // flagged
requiredEnv.HOME; // flagged
require('node:process').env.HOME; // flagged
const { HOME } = process.env; // flagged
const { HOME: fromEnv } = env; // flagged
const { env: { HOME: nested } } = processNamespace; // flagged
const { HOME: fromRequired } = requiredProcess.env; // flagged
process.env.PATH;
env.PATH;
// The imported module is exactly process for a platform guard.
it.skipIf(process.platform === 'win32')('a', fn);
// A fixture parameter named process or env is not the module.
const readEnv = (process) => process.env.HOME;
const readFixtureEnv = (env) => env.HOME;
const readFixtureProcess = ({ env }) => env.HOME;
